_doc: Scene list for tools/debug/warp.py. route: cold-boot route; frames: run length; mash: touch-mash after the route; warp: [chapter, area] = New Game starts in that stage and plays its own intro (tools/debug/warp.lua, docs/re/events.md). shows: what the scene proves.

title.shows: title menu, (C) line, ぼうけんをはじめる button

entry_card.shows: signature screen: top prompt, はじめから panel, Entry card

new_adventure.shows: あたらしいぼうけんをはじめます + はい/いいえ portraits

book.shows: The Belt of Deltora book cover (graphic)

dialogue.shows: just before the first narration + portrait dialogue in the castle library; text viewer base state

prologue_end.shows: end of the touch-mashed opening, player control in the library

ch1.shows: chapter 1 (ちんもくの森) intro, Barda tutorial, battle HUD

ch2.shows: chapter 2 (なげきのみずうみ) intro

ch6.shows: chapter 6 (まもののどうくつ) intro

tower.shows: むげんの塔 floor, gameplay HUD

boss_ch1.shows: chapter 1 area 3: Wennbar boss fight (biorhythm, special moves)

paint.shows: portrait dialogue then parchment screen (script 1817, CallPaint)

game_over.shows: no input until the Wennbar wins: GAME OVER + 'Lief's party has fallen...' (G10)

menu.shows: field menu (bottom-right icon): そうび/だいじ/そざい/カード/アイテム labels

cutscene_1798.shows: cinematic dialogue layout: scene on top, centred text + portrait on black bottom screen
